title: kramers: an open handbook of first-passage and escape results
description: An open Python library and handbook of first-passage and escape results in statistical physics. Each published formula is a function tied to its paper, equation and page, and is checked against an independent numerical solver (quadrature, time-dependent Fokker-Planck, simulation).
notes: Developed with AI-assisted tools; every number reruns (the test suite and the nightly verification recompute every value).
